status: Native isolated GDK backport builds and passes Debian GTK ABI load. Diagnostic GTK64 presentation passes; a fresh frozen-payload qualification is required.
cause: The old GDK GLES software fallback unconditionally uses GL_RGBA on non-Windows platforms, then treats bytes as Cairo native BGRA. GTK uploads that Cairo surface and explicitly swaps channels, displaying the wrong colour.
fix: For little-endian GLES, select GL_BGRA when GL_EXT_read_format_bgra is available. Retain the old fallback otherwise. No RTL or Mesa channel special case and no CPU conversion added.

build.scope: GDK GLES fallback uses native BGRA readback when supported; no shader/channel workaround or CPU conversion added.

abi_check: ctypes.CDLL(libgtk-3.so.0, RTLD_NOW) with the isolated library passed; X11, Wayland and Broadway enabled to match Debian GTK references.
visual_review: Viewed frozen 64x64 frame; complete orange rectangle with dark border. Full640 desktop/window layout remains pending.
evidence_limit: Diagnostic QEMU guest had libraries changed after boot. Do not count it as a frozen-payload model qualification or use elapsed time as a performance comparison. Failed profiles remain separate.
